defs.def: a large ball of burning gas in space that we see as a point of light in the sky at night 恒星；星

ex.s: With water falling off it thick, brown hair, the bear stared back at me.
ex.t: 水从它浓密的棕色毛发上流下来，那只熊也瞪着我看。

ex.s: He invented twelve new instruments to study stars and planets.
ex.t: 他发明了十二种新的仪器来研究恒星和行星。

ex.s: Head Chef David Thompson, who received a Michelin star for his Loodon-based Thai restaurant of the same name, opened this branch in the Metropolitan Hotel in 2010.
ex.t: 主厨大卫·汤普森曾凭借其位于伦敦的同名泰国餐厅获得米其林一星，他于2010年在大都会酒店开设了这家分店。

ex.s: Leslie Nielsen’s childhood was a difficult one, but he had one particular shining star in his life — his uncle, who was a well-known actor.
ex.t: 莱斯利·尼尔森的童年很艰难，但他生命中有一颗特别闪亮的星——他的叔叔，一位知名演员。

ex.s: For example, in English, "the stars are out" means "the stars can be seen in the sky", but "the lights are out" means "the lights are off".
ex.t: 例如，在英语中，the stars are out的意思是星星在天空中可以看到，但the lights are out的意思是灯熄灭了。

ex.s: That is why when the stars are out, they are visible, but when the lights are out, they are invisible.
ex.t: 这就是为什么当星星出来时，它们可以看到，但当灯熄灭时，它们就看不到了。

ex.s: Walk 3 — Moonlight Under the Stars
ex.t: 路线3——星空下的月光

ex.s: Moonlight Under the Stars.
ex.t: 月光照众星下。

defs.def: an object, a decoration, a mark, etc., usually with five or six points, whose shape represents a star 星状物；星形饰物；星号
a mark that represents a star and tells you how good sth is, especially a hotel or restaurant （尤指旅馆或餐馆的）星级
a famous and excellent singer, performer, sports player, etc. 歌唱（或表演）明星；体坛高手；才华出众者

ex.s: This is when a pop star draws far more attention than, say, gradual biodiversity decline.
ex.t: 这就是当一位流行明星比，比如说，渐进的生物多样性衰退吸引更多关注时的情况。

ex.s: Meet a star reporter.
ex.t: 见到一位明星记者。

ex.s: Every weekend this is “Wales” premier comedy club where having a great time is the order for both audiences and comedy stars alike.
ex.t: 每个周末这里都是"威尔士"顶级喜剧俱乐部，观众和喜剧明星都能在这里度过美好时光。

ex.s: If a basketball star is. for example，trying to gain a high personal point total，he may take a shot himself when it would be better to pass the ball to a teammate，affecting the team's performance.
ex.t: 例如，如果一个篮球明星试图获得更高的个人得分总数，在把球传给队友可能更好的情况下，他可能会自己投篮，从而影响球队的表现。

ex.s: Anyway, grandpa is now an internet star—two minutes of fame!
ex.t: 不管怎样，爷爷现在是个网络明星——两分钟的名气！

ex.s: It is hard to name a comedy star who hasn’t been on the stage here.
ex.t: 很难说出哪位喜剧明星没有在这个舞台上演出过。

ex.s: He often interviews internet stars.
ex.t: 他经常采访互联网明星。

ex.s: To see famous film stars.
ex.t: 见著名电影明星。

ex.s: Stars apparently do not follow this basic principle of sportsmanship.
ex.t: 明星们显然没有遵循这项运动精神的基本原则。

ex.s: Become the next star reporter, news writer, director or producer.
ex.t: 成为下一代明星记者、新闻撰稿人、总监或制片人。

ex.s: A footballer dreaming of becoming a movie star.
ex.t: 一个梦想成为电影明星的足球运动员。

ex.s: The project results from the difficulties many schools have in getting artists of any sort - whether an up-and-coming local musician or a major movie star - into schools to work with and inspire children.
ex.t: 该项目源于许多学校在邀请任何类型的艺术家——无论是崭露头角的本地音乐人还是大牌电影明星——进入学校与儿童合作并启发他们时所面临的困难。

ex.s: But they weren’t there to throw red paint on fur-coat-wearing film stars.
ex.t: 但他们并不是来向穿皮草外套的电影明星泼红漆的。

ex.s: Become the next star reporter news writer, director or producer.
ex.t: 孩子们和他们的营友在经营我们自己的新闻站的各个方面时，将创作并主持每晚晚餐时向整个营地播出的广播节目。

defs.def: a person who has the main part, or one of the main parts, in a film/movie, play, etc. （电影、戏剧等的）主角，主演
a person or thing that is the best of a group 常用于另一名词前
a description of what sb thinks is going to happen to sb in the future, based on the position of the stars and planets when they were born 星象（根据人出生时天体的位置而描述的命运）

ex.s: What time does Dave's meeting star?
ex.t: Helen打算做什么？

ex.s: What time does Dave's meeting star?
ex.t: Helen打算做什么？

defs.def: to have one of the main parts in a film/movie, play, etc. 主演；担任主角

ex.s: He is a star actor of Children’s Theatre, having played leading roles in “The Legend of Sleepy Hollow” and “The Wizard of Oz,” and is fresh from Jersey Production “Ragtime.”
ex.t: 他是儿童剧院的明星演员，曾在《沉睡谷传奇》和《绿野仙踪》中担任主角，刚从Jersey制作《Ragtime》中走出。

ex.s: She has turned down several  67  (invitation) to star at shows in order to concentrate on her studies.
ex.t: 她为了专心学业，已拒绝了数次  67  （邀请）在演出中担任主演。

defs.def: if a film/movie, play, etc. stars sb, that person has one of the main parts 使主演；由 … 担任主角
to put a symbol shaped like a star (= an asterisk) next to a word, etc. in order to make people notice it 给 … 标星号
